integrity: The proof is symbolic and self-contained after the standard spherical support-function criterion; no numerical experiment is used to establish the threshold.
limitations: Sharp only for the explicit cubic family \(h_{\alpha,\beta}\) in \(\mathbb R^3\); no classification of all triangular-projection-symmetry bodies is claimed. Targeted searches did not reveal the exact threshold, but an older equivalent statement under different notation remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp convexity threshold for the cubic constant-width support family \(h_{\alpha,\beta}(u)=\alpha+\beta u_1u_2u_3\)
